sourceMeta.title: Mr SAM

sourceReview.notes: Original Faculty of Medicine report confirms the January 2024 launch of five Mr.SAM outpatient-service robots. This source supersedes the earlier secondary-only reference and its conflicting rollout timing. No journal research paper or clinical certification established.

previousSourceReview.notes: Secondary report found; it describes planned March 2024 rollout, not a completed deployment at publication. Photo attributed to Bangkok Post, so no primary-source photo selected.
previousSourceReview.scope: Source attribution and reported functions only; not independent capability or clinical validation.
